introHtml: Heat transfer decoration lets you add vibrant, full-color logos to toys, games, and party supplies without the setup costs of embroidery or screen printing. This method works well on polyester blends and smooth surfaces, making it ideal for custom plush toys, event giveaways, and branded game pieces. Perfect for trade shows, employee appreciation gifts, or promotional events where you need soft-touch branding that won't peel or crack.
